redactions.original: deficiencies in income tax for 2014, 2015, and 2016 of $8,725, $7,085, and $5,890
We find that she properly filed as head of household for 2015 and 2016. However, she has not established that she is entitled to the education credit for 2014.
On the basis of our factual findings petitioner is entitled to head of household filing status for 2015 and 2016.
Accordingly, she is not entitled to the education credit for 2014.
Decision will be entered under Rule 155.

facts_from_discussion: The court found that the records petitioner submitted do not establish that she paid tuition in 2014.
